slots.jd.office-supply.about:
About us and the job
Brightside Office Supply is a regional office-supply distributor, owned and run by the people who started it. We help local businesses keep their offices stocked and running. We are hiring a Sales Development Representative to find new customers and get them set up with us. The job is hybrid, with regular days working alongside the team at our Louisville office.
slots.jd.office-supply.duties:
What the job involves
- Find and contact businesses in our area that could become new accounts
- Talk with prospects to learn what they order and how often
- Prepare quotes and help put together contracts with the owner and sales team
- Keep track of every prospect and follow up on time
- Hand new customers over to our customer success team with clear notes so nothing is missed
slots.jd.office-supply.needs:
What you need
- 2 or more years of experience in business-to-business sales
- Cold outreach by phone and email, and comfort using Sales Navigator to find prospects
- Product demonstrations that are clear and focused on what the customer needs
- Account planning and pipeline management for a steady list of prospects
- Sales forecasting that gives the owner an honest view of what is coming in
slots.r1.b1: Qualifies incoming leads in Salesforce against agreed criteria, lifting lead qualification rates by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Runs product demonstrations that help prospects define their needs before quotes and contracts are prepared for review.
slots.r1.b3: Reports cold outreach activity and results in pipeline reviews, contributing to a 50 percent increase in booked meetings.
slots.r1.b4: Uses territory planning to organize assigned accounts and prepares clear notes for each handoff to customer success.
slots.r1.i1: Qualifies incoming leads for Brightwater Labs, confirming each prospect's fit before passing it on for follow-up.
slots.r1.i2: Prospects new accounts for Brightwater Labs through research and outreach, building a steady list of qualified contacts.
slots.summary.1: Early-career business-to-business sales professional who handles routine prospect requests, with a colleague reviewing the work. Skilled in product demonstrations, cold outreach and territory planning, with a B.A. in Business Administration from State University.
slots.summary.2: Business-to-business sales associate with hands-on experience in cold outreach, territory planning and product demonstrations at Brightwater Labs. Handles routine requests from prospects, with the work checked by a colleague before it goes out.
